newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Kabila will enter Kinshasa on Tuesday - Mandela.
newsitem.headline: Kabila will enter Kinshasa on Tuesday - Mandela.

text.p: Zaire's new leader Laurent Kabila will enter Kinshasa on Tuesday and address his nation, South African President Nelson Mandela said on Monday.

Mandela, on a state visit here, told Zimbabwe state television that he had discussed Zaire with Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe during an hour-long talk, and said both leaders were happy with the largely peaceful end to the Zaire crisis.

"He (Kabila) will enter Kinshasa tomorrow without bloodshed and his troops have been acknowledged as being disciplined and courteous," he said, adding that Kabila would also address his nation on Tuesday.
Mandela, whose South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki met Kabila on Sunday, gave no further details.
